plan.quality_protocol: Same 16 cases per model as original primary: 8 grounded, 2 code with 5 tests each, 4 vision, arithmetic, reasoning. Sidecar/default thinking; temperature1,top_p0.95,top_k20,min_p0;4096 output budget;no seed or penalties. No output grammar. One sampled trial; retain scored failures without reruns.
plan.throughput_protocol: Same sampler and context. Each model/modality: one discarded128-token warmup,3 serial measured resident requests;512 text tokens,256 vision tokens. Native lastRequest timings exclude load and prefill. Prefix reuse remains default. No concurrent builds/tests launched by this task.
plan.admission: Normal standard machine lease and request admission remain enabled. Admission-only startup failures retained and retried normally; no floor overrides.
plan.comparison_scope: Compare primary quality and throughput with the pre-fix report; previous secondary presence/budget probe is not repeated.
plan.infrastructure_resumption: Quality resumes identical completed request receipts; scored quality failures are never regenerated. Interrupted throughput cohorts are preserved separately and a fresh complete cohort reruns after warmups. Measured timing variation alone does not trigger retries.
plan.throughput_contamination_policy: Retain every sample and process observation. Active competing native inference, tests, or compiler work triggers a contention flag and a complete fresh cohort after that work exits. Queued idle test processes are documented separately, not treated as active inference. Contemporaneous admission and CPU snapshots distinguish these states. Timing variation alone never triggers retries or sample selection.

throughput_cohort_selection.reason: Unrelated active XCTest overlapped initial throughput. Repeated all 24 requests as one fresh cohort, without selecting by speed. Quality was not repeated.

limits: One unseeded sampled quality trial; counts are not broad benchmark scores or a causal before/after estimate.
Strict JSON parsing and selected expected-value checks; not a complete schema or human quality assessment.
Fence recovery is a separate diagnostic and does not change primary scores.
Throughput includes reasoning tokens and excludes loading and prefill; image-prompt decoder speed is not images per second.
Interactive desktop; process and thermal telemetry do not prove every background GPU workload was absent.
